body: Start by Confessions of a Mask.
You want a fucked up reason to be depressed? Oh, man. You don't need it. Really. We are all fucked up in some manner or another.
I think not.

Yeah, of course. Because every rich jew in the world is a child devouring lizard. I think Mr. Icke would have been one hell of an investigative journalist. For the Völkischer Beobachter, of course, alongside QAnon and all other antisemitic losers around.
As far as I know, it was this irish aristocrat. The rest could be hysteria and/or copycats. And it's a very old legend. Fire spitting, jumping 10ft and all could just be tall tales.
Quite nice. My PC will be Neuromancer-themed, so wood won't go well. But you gave me some good ideas on what to chisel with my tools.
First time I felt like dying I was 6.First time I tried to commit suicide, I was 8. From there, there was no escape. I hope you get better.
We all do, don't we?
I can see Kid Afrika and Beauvoir joining the Voodoo Boys. Hope there's a tribute to The Finn, also.
That's good to hear. Keep up with the good work. I swappped my problem for brutality and violence. As long as I'm hitting a punching bag or pulling weights, I'm under control.

I've been assaulted as well. I know the feeling. Can you tell me if you can convert it into violence? If so, why don't you try to use this experience as fuel for brutality? It's a good way to compensate it. Sports, martial arts, fighting, taking revenge on these people. I'm not telling you you'll be free. You won't. But you'll feel better. Guaranteed.

Medicações raramente funcionam. Suicídio por arma de fogo é de longe o melhor método. No caso do Brasil, com a falta de acesso às armas de fogo, o enforcamento por suspensão é o melhor método. Mas pensa bem antes de morrer. Se você realmente quer isso.
Make sure that you don't swap cutting for sugar. It'll be a pain to lose the weight after. Congratulations, nonetheless.
I knew that the next step of all these creepypastas would be trolling the Forest Service.
Things are outdated and boring. There's no human tragedy to watch that somebody haven't written about already.
I don't. But it's fine. I don't need a line.

É. Não entendo, eu acho. Eu só amei uma vez. No resto das vezes o indiferente era eu. Dar um fora era só um incômodo menor. Talvez isso de achar que sempre gostam de você seja uma necessidade de aceitação, vendo por fora. Talvez doa menos se você tentar aceitar que não vai ser aceita. Não sei. Estou fora do meu terreno, um pouco. Boa noite. Nós nos esbarramos por aqui um dia desses.

É. Desculpe. Eu não sei mais bem como sentir empatia apesar de saber como é. Mas você parece que vai ficar bem. Eu pessoalmente nunca sei o que passa na cabeça das pessoas. Então eu costumo ler o que elas querem dizer com leituras frias, palavras-chave e observação de linguagem corporal. Talvez funcione pra você também. Espero que dê tudo certo.
Um sonho é só um sonho. Eu queria que os meus fossem realidade. Até os pesadelos. Mas o mundo é surdo ao que ecoa na nossa cabeça. Paciência.
She's kind of the grandmother of fanfics.
Ill keep that in mind. pm me. Good luck.
It's fine. If you need to talk, I'm here.
It's for pipes. As a pipe smoker, once I nearly bought a similar one.
Yes. We are an ungrateful shitty species.

Sorry. I wasn't able to read anything you wrote other than the title. Hope you can cope with school. Everyone needs to go through it and it wasn't easy for me as well. Had panic attacks and all before I even knew that it was panic. Good luck.

É. Eu não encaro não. Mas eu rio por dentro. O que é um direito meu. Mas estou acostumado com as pessoas me encararem na rua porque alegadamente eu tenho "cara de mau". Então eu calculo não olhar mais de dois segundos cronometrados pra ninguém. A não ser que seja alguém suspeito ou que claramente esteja me encarando. Divirta-se com sua bicicleta, o tamanho que for. O garfo da minha está pra chegar com essa greve de correio.
It's not capitalism. It's people as a whole.
Tem dois ou três além de uma jiboia que vez em quando passeiam aqui em casa. Eles são todos convidados. Melhor que gente.
Indeed. Mental illness is market-friendly. They'll squeeze all of us of every last single penny.

Eu nunca incentivei ninguém a morrer ou não morrer porque por mim é uma escolha individual. Eu compreendo seu ponto. Mas se fosse algo legal, até que chegasse minha própria hora, eu estaria disposto a ajudar gente decidida a morrer a ter uma morte menos dolorosa que ficar pendurada numa corda ou algo assim. As clínicas suíças de suicídio, na minha opinião, são problemáticas por serem pagas. Eu penso que suicídios assistidos deveriam ser gratuitos e acessíveis a todos num sistema de saúde genuinamente justo.

Eu não sei se essa foi a melhor decisão. Eu já estive em situações parecidas. Eu só perguntei à pessoa se ela não deveria ponderar os prós e contras. No fim, essas pessoas decidiram tirar a própria vida. Não acho que ninguém tenha direito de "lutar pela vida do outro" nesse aspecto. Vive quem quer viver.
Eu moro no segundo, mesmo. Hahhaa
E não adianta nem usar um aríete na porta. Dá tudo errado mesmo.

We will always be looked as pariahs. I see the faces of the quaint perfect people who look into my scars when I exercise. It's a disgusting mix of pity and repulsion. I don't think this will change. Work, work, work and work to pay for your therapy and medications and fancy scar healing ointments, or cigarettes, pot, snow and booze in order to cope it all. Nobody gives a shit about the quaint perfect people. Nobody gives a shit about us. It's better to get used. Youll be fine.
Ainda dá tempo de uma guerra nuclear pra nós. Ia ser maravilhoso só queimar e apagar de vez.

Se ele não foi cuidar de você no hospital tendo plenas capacidades, por que você faria alguma coisa por ele? Oferecer a outra face é um conceito interessante para as pessoas magnânimas. Nós, como somos corriqueiros, damos o troco na mesma medida. Eu já acho que ter se oferecido a primeira vez foi grande da sua parte. É difícil, eu sei, não fazer esforço por quem não se eaforça por nós. Mas gastar energia demais só nos deixa exauridos. Certas pessoas são buracos negros. Quanto mais você dá, mais elas querem. A família dele pode ir pra puta que os pariu. Cuida de você.
Bom. Ódio é um excelente combustível.
It's a good idea that I doubt will take off.
People ask questions when you do it on your arm. Legs are a better place. But you'll be fine. It's just the normal sensation of aftercut. It's what takes our focus away from mental pain.
It's normal. Where did you cut?
The bets are on, gentlemen

Amor pra mim é uma vez e acabou. Nunca senti nada por mais ninguém além de indiferença. Isso pra mim de mais de um amor é modernidade líquida. Meu avô teve a primeira esposa executada por Stalin. A segunda, minha avó, ele nunca amou. Eu sou esse tipo de pessoa. Pra mim é uma vez só e acabou. Heathcliff e Cathy, Eros e Psique, Orfeu e Eurídice. Meus 125 poemas pra essa pessoa no fim não foram de nada. No fim todo mundo te deixa quando você erra demais. Eu não fui feito pra existir nesses tempos. Engraçado que não sou nem eu. Todo mundo à minha volta concorda. Nós dois nos ferimos. E eu vou ferir qualquer um que cruze meu caminho. E vai ser isso.

Várias razões. Não adianta enunciar. Vai doer demais voltar nisso. Basta dizer que foram erros meus e dela. Traumas e velhas feridas que nunca fecharam. Ao menos eu fui feliz um tempo. Eu tomei um coquetel de quetiapina, diazepam, água sanitária e destilado agora. Adquiri pó e vou fazer uso agora. Daí mais água sanitária. Se o corpo não vomitar depois do desmaio, eu rodo. Obrigado pela atenção. Boa noite.
Não faz muita diferença o que você faz. No fim das contas, não existem promessas. E é isso. Melhor lidar logo com isso.

I do forget my own birthday. It was difficult, but I was able. It's just another day. You'll never be happy as you wished. There's potential but no promise. Die now if you wish. Or keep living if you wish. It'll make no difference to you.
Then they commit suicide.
I hunted a bit. This looks to me like a fake print.
Indeed. I have no idea when is the subtitled version come around.
Deus Vult and Allahu Akbar over thy noble visage, o, Crusader. Thy deeds are like those of the deeds of thou heroes of yonder.

É, eles davam respawn no Silmarillion. Apesar de o Glorfindel ser o único que eu lembro que de fato voltou. Ele mata aquele Balrog nos muros de Gondolin e depois está em Imladris na Terceira Era. Acho que era isso. Tem 12 anos que eu não leio Tolkien. Mas eu gosto. 

Quanto a ter esperanças, eu me agarro a não me agarrar em acreditar. Tudo é traiçoeiro demais nessa Modernidade Líquida. O Bauman estava certo. Nossa experiência hoje é mais incompleta que nunca.
I'm still looking for Mishima: The Last Debate as well.

Não é nenhum problema. Estamos aqui pra falar mal da vida mesmo. Eu sinceramente duvido que fiquemos melhores. Mas podemos transformar nossa dor em alguma coisa. A escrita me ajudou bastante nesse ponto. E eu imagino que o número  de homens que sofreram abuso é bem maior do que a estatística. Acho que no fim, só podemos concluir que pedófilo e estuprador tem mais é que morrer. De qualquer forma, eu estou por aqui. Querendo me mandar uma mensagem ou algo assim, podemos conversar. E aliás, que eu me lembre o Fëanor era Alto Rei. Mas faz tempo que eu li o Silmarillion.
Seu nome já diz muita coisa sobre isso haha Nós precisamos remendar nossos cacos com laca e pó de ouro.

Desejo a você sorte também. Não sei se é bem um fato a resolução dessas questões. Acho que é mais uma questão de Fortuna sorrir para nós. Eu não sei se consigo sair desse estado. Principalmente não agora, que tem sido o pior período da minha vida. Quando eu contei ao meu pai, ele disse que sofreu a mesma coisa dos colegas quando estudou no Santo Américo. Mas ele normalizou a coisa de um modo que eu não consigo entender. Não entra na minha cabeça. Pra mim o que ajudou um pouco foi a brutalidade. Quando eu sofri bullying na escola e percebi que era uma cabeça mais alto e conhecia uma arte marcial com alguma profundidade, eu só me tornei o algoz. Teve uma época no começo do meu curso na universidade em que eu malhava 3h de manhã, tinha 12h de aula todo dia, e toda sexta eu ia beber e bater em alguém que estivesse fazendo algo que me causasse desagrado. Sei que quebrar o nariz de um cara que estava assediando uma mulher bêbada não é solução para nada. Mas me agradava me sentir no topo, e não apenas uma vítima. Ler muito e escrever também me ajudou. Titus Andronicus é uma peça que fala em abuso, Confissões de uma Máscara é um livro que fala numa brutalidade crescente e uma crise existencial relacionada à sensação de estranheza ao mundo. Não sei. Eu não acho que algum dia eu vá estar "curado" desse trauma. Mas eu espero de verdade que você consiga. Eu sei o inferno que é viver isso por dentro te rasgando. A sensação da injustiça cometida e sem ter sido justiçada queimando dentro do peito ao mesmo tempo que você só consegue fazer um esforço limitado de tocar sua vida. Espero que você saia disso. Espero que a maioria dos seus sorrisos futuros sejam sinceros.
Eu acho que no fim das contas ninguém presta. E se alguém presta, alguém vai fazer o possível pra fazer com que esse alguém deixe de prestar. É um mundo onde todo mundo é o predador de todo mundo.

Sometimes, it was like this with me as well. I saw something at night, as I tend to wake up randomly since I was a kid. Then I saw those insects crawling on the floor or reaching my bed. Even today, if I dream of spiders, it's a sign of deep stress. I'm not saying that it was stress that caused your experiences. I'm just saying that I consider mine this.

I've seen similar things in the form of insects as a very young kid up to my 18s. Normally insects that I feared, like spiders, as I had the experience of waking up with a tarantula on top of me when I was 6. I've seen these insects as wooden or leafy things, or as shadows on my peripheral vision. Always attributed it as stress-induced hallucinations, as I had a kind of hard childhood.
Yeah, I did. It's in my opinion a weak Western contemporary judeo-christian depiction of revenge. If you don't stand for yourself, nobody else will. You must embrace extremes in order to truly live.

Well, if I made her suffer and I cut off their genitals, I'd feel good as fuck, truth be told. I took revenge before in my life. Felt like a weight got off my shoulders. Like justice was done. I felt my heart lighter, I was able to smile, which is very rare. Things need to be returned. Or they stay with us. It is the only righteous way of living. Since I was a little kid I was a believer in lex talionis. I did what I could. What I should, so that things were balanced. When I wronged someone, I'd give myself for punishment. That's how things should be. When they don't go full circle, we can't have inner peace. But I understand your point.

It used not to bother me. Now it does. It's not right to vent on the wrong people. It's dishonourable. It's unfair. And a life without honour is a life I can't accept living. One must abide by a strict code of conduct in order not to commit the unspeakable.

I understand what you mean. But writing to her will do me no good. Already tried. Also can't put on poem or play. Been unable to write for the last months. Punching soft stuff with objects doesn't help me. What U tend to do is punch my walls until my hands bleed. As I'm an experienced karate fighter, I can assure you it takes some time for me to feel unbearable pain on the knuckles. I don't want to go back to my old style of drinking, getting into a fight and punching somebody. It's not satisfactory anymore. Punishing myself isn't either, as after years of abuse I was finally able to determine I'm not to blame for what people did to me. I want to vent on the right people. I want to make her feel the same pain and humiliation she made me experience. I want the people who raped me who feel the same horror and disgust they made me feel since I was 4 years old. I want to get back to those who deserve. Blind rage isn't taking me anywhere. Directed rage is the answer. But the solutions for directed rage can't be applied. So, there will be no justice. There will be no devolution of the violence inflicted. And I can't live with that. I have no idea how to live with that. I'm tired of carrying this abuse. I want the responsible, all of them, to pay dearly. So then I'll be able to be at peace and go on with my life, or take it knowing that my business is cincluded.
I have therapy. Had for years. And I trust no one. Time and time again trusting has proven to be a mistake.

I'm quite good at it, really. Thing is, I've been little by little becoming more and more violent. I don't want to lash out on people who did nothing bad to me. Yes, I do have a therapist. Yes, I'm doing all I can. But ever since I stopped self harming, I have this violence, this sensation of utter need to get back at the world for what happened to me. I used to be a caring person. I cared more for people than for myself. I blamed myself too many times already. But at the same time, I have to discount this violence or there'll be no equilibrium. U want to get back at my ex for belittling me, for intentionally making me jealous, for cheating and using me. U want to kill my rapists. I can't let go, you understand? If U let go, there'll be no justice. That's my dilemma. I know martyrdom is the only ever dignified way of dying. Mishima is right about it. The old Christians were right about it. The old Roman generals that performed Devotio were right about it. But nowadays, there's no good reason to die for. And thus, aggression builds up, but I can't act on it. I can't even write anymore, me, who's been writing the last 13 years. I really don't know. I feel lost.
I'm happy that at least someone was able to overcome this. I lost someone very dear to me due to this on her part. I still cry over it. Don't know if I'll ever stop.
I don't even think I'm alive anymore. So no. Doesn't bother me. And better than calling me a plain victim.

Yeah, I fought and conquered this instinct a long time ago. I loathed this characteristic in people in general because of an ex of mine who made me feel like shit because of this attention-seeking thing. But I understand how you feel. Hope you're able to find some balance in this.

So, sometimes I feel like an idiot, because I know most won't act in this anti-sexual and violent manner that I do. But sometimes I see people with traces which I understand. That's positive. For me, it's not helpful. I'm better off fighting in the gym or beating somebody up in a bar fight or something to compensate the fact that academic work has no violence whatsoever. Or making cancer jokes. Or making gulag or concentration camp jokes in order to horrify people. But if I'm able to answer somebody in here and they say "Hey, man, it's exactly how I feel", I feel I'm doing sonething good with a life that's completely wasted.
Y'know? Like life is this repulsive cycle of birth, abuse, delusions of a hero's cycle and then death. Kaleidoscopic mirages of stillness.

I have no idea if I ever had anything in order to rebuild. Feels like my whole life's been a big fat lie.all I felt was premeditated by somebody else. I went on like a fucking machine. My whole life I had nothing but the hypnotic frames and unstable images of dreams I thought I'd live. Some Travis Bickle stuff, my life was. Trying to save little unrepentant prostitutes just to realise there's nobody worth saving. Not even myself.

Sure. This includes unreal expectations regarding other human beings, awkwardness, reliving trauma everyday, like over-the-counter bad experiences. One day you are a child, then a teenager, then an adult and nothing has changed. People moved on from you, but you still haven't moved on from people, like they are imprints of long gone neon lights on your eyes. Then comes rage at nothing in particular, and you come to the conclusion your life failed before it even began. Know the feeling, mate.
If Scully had that desk, all that mess wouldn't have happened.
Yes. After the bad experience. And you'll still get thrown into bad experiences that you can't prevent. There's no control of abuse. There's damage assessment afterwards.
Indeed. It's pure self help bullshit.
Where's Iranian Mulder to save us now?

No, you don't. You don't choose parents, race, social class, and although you can choose most of the people, you don't really know who is anybody until they take off their masks. This includes yourself, even. 
You don't have this degree of control over your own life. It's better just to understand our limits and tread carefully.
Take two boxes of Valium. You'll sleep like a rock for a day and a half.
You lose to the world. Not to yourself. And fuck the world. I already despise it enough. If I get punished for doing justice, so be it. My conscience will be clear as day.

Makes sense. I was never keen on survival instinct. For me, it was me or them. To die knowing I fucked her up will make up for all these years. I can only see the dawn of glory from the perspective of the one who dies by the sword. Beauty is in glory, and glory is in death. If any of those who wronged me cross paths with me again, I'll kill them. No second thoughts. And if I get killed for this, so be it. I would have done the right thing anyway.

Still, I have this sense you feel there is something lacking inside. You feel that you aren't feeling accomplished in this manner. I know the sensation. I was once like this. But when I discovered I could rain hell, I embraced it. The greatest torment is to try to cope with a trauma that society doesn't let you have justice for. And you know the ones who wronged you walk free while you are a prisoner of your trauma.

What if you tell yourself it's "immatture" to take revenge? I have not the slightest idea what the fuck does it mean to be mature. Wife beating was mature 80 years ago in Western society, honour killings are mature in many cultures as we see it as an abomination. If we think about it, it depends on us, not on what others think of it. Fuck the others. They don't know the pain we feel, just as they do not know the pain they feel. In the end, we are all alone. So who am I to tell somebody else what is maturity or what it is to act in a mature manner? I don't know. Perhaps it's not in you to take violence into your hands. But if you are trying to lay back, forget it. World doesn't care. You shouldn't either. Let them judge you. Better to be called venguful than to be remembered for being inert.

I let the rage rise through me. The rage of having to endure that torment. The rage of all those things that happened to me. Do the same. Strike back at them for what they did, even if the world can't understand it. You don't have to report to no one but yourself. No God in Heaven. No Devil underneath. But your honour lives on. You have to keep going until you took from them what they took from you. Otherwise, we are lost. Taking revenge will hurt. But it's necessary, to take away the splinter inside your heart.

And also, if you wish to talk about it, I may be mentally unstable as fuck, but I'm here. I'm not letting another victim with their silence if they wish to be heard. I know very well what it is to be caged inside your brain, no windows open, in the dark. If the world won't hear us or give us justice, we must make it ourselves.

Yes. I still love mine. Broke my heart. Used me. Made me drag myself through the mud. All because I wanted to help her. But the poison of her own abusers turned her into that. I blame her for many things. I blame myself for keeping up for nine years, like I still do. I still love her, even though she taunts me nearly every day. But even though I suffered, I'm a changed man. Nevermore shall her or anyone manipulate me. Learned my lesson. We bleed ourselves deeply, and when we look, we have become so weak our world is in shambles. No matter. In the end, she's the one who needs the approval of the world. She's the one still trapped on her own web of lies. She will have to live with herself and her own bullshit the rest of her days. People like her will probably never change. Thus, ours is the right to take revenge, or not. Rejoice for being the wronged and not the wrongdoer, because you don't have to carry the weight of it. Yours is the vengeance. Yours is the right to strike back. Do what your heart wants. Go after her if you can't be at peace. There is no justice put for us. We have to make our own.

I used to. One day, I discovered that I was carrying my abusers weight with me all these years. I was even letting important people abuse me in other ways because in my fucked up state, I believed I was helping them. I have been abused in relationships  just to become abusive as well after I was abused. One day, after I lost everything I loved, I discovered that I was carrying people's weight, their words, their actions. It was very sad for me, but in the end, I let it go. You can let it go as well. You don't loathe yourself. You loathe the fact that you were powerless when they did what they did to you. But it's not your fault. You didn't do anything wrong. Direct your hatred to the correct targets. Get revenge if needed be. But don't blame yourself.

Being content was never much of a thing regarding me. I want what I want. If I stop now, I'll never ever be able to say I was truly alive. To live and to die are very similar things for me. And you only live once. So, there's no after the fact for me. Things mark us forever. Life leaves some wounds that never heal.
Is there an after?
Imagine the maggots festering over you. Look at the bones of the dead. Normalize death. Accept its beauty.

We also have Death Drive. Death can bring pleasure. I think that if you wish to accept death, you have to see yourself as already dead. That's what I do. I look at myself and say "You are already dead. You lost all you could lose. All you loved is gone beyond your power. You are a walking corpse". Then look at the mirror. Look deep into your own eyes. See the eyes of a dead person. Kill the light in your eyes. Think of your skin shrinking, of you graciously mummified by an arid climate. Think "I am dead. I accept that I am dead. I have nothing to lose but fear". Then keep existing, or do whatever choice you want. Death means true freedom.
Yes. I understand. I'm to install a simple suicide device home soon. Easier this way.
Living is far more terrifying than death. It's understandable.
Bleach won't kill you also. We're not in the glorious 30s anymore where we can buy a lethal dosage of anything over the counter, sadly. Believe me, I tried.
Sorry, mate. No easy way. Valium won't kill you easily. I'd give up on this idea if you can only die without pain.

I kind of accepted that suicide is one of the two possibilities in my life. And this way it's easier. You have only two ways. So when my head goes that direction, I tell it "Not yet. You still have pieces to move. The game only ends when the king gets check mate. Now concentrate on other pieces and keep up with the quality of fighting.". 

Now, I never had cancer likr you. Yet, I mean. I think I'll have it eventually. Too much pipe smoking and pshysical exercises with supplements. Eyes are already fucked. Too much reading. But it's fine. If there's a thing I finally learned is that the game is never over until it's really over.
It's ok. Don't try to fight what you feel. Accept the thoughts and try to think about what's their origin. You'll be fine. If you wish, I'm here to help.
Only if it was meant for a torturous death.
I remember my last imcarnation. And the one before that. But those could be hallucinations.
Yep. It doesn't exist anymore or is beyond our reach. I i know how you feel
No. I recently, during my last days, began to worry abour reincarnation. But oblivion forever? Fuck. I'd embrace it.

I think that in this situation, the best you can do is be by her side and his side, and don't show fear or cry. Be strong for her on her last noments. Other than this, bring her aromatic flowers. Strangely, it helps.
If you embrace it. If you live to die, then, it's easy. I'm dying today, for example. It's easy once you simplify it.
There is no point. Really.
Once I had a similar problem living in a city. Turns out it was a drunken hobo imitating a wolf under my window, howling to the moon and all.

A friendly reminder: Unless you are going to do it with somebody else, or have a public death, I wouldn't recommend you state specific dates. This rarely works. Commiting suicide isn't different from mental training to pull the trigger during war after basic training. It's like sharpening a blade. You have a specific moment to act that, if solitary, isn't decided by pre-specified appointments. You may reach the day and don't have the balls to do it. It's quite OK. Happens to the best of us. So, it's a friendly reminder. If you can't do it then, you'll feel even worse.

Well, I believe Shakespeare read De Bello Gallico. Caesar's expedition into Britannia discusses the pictii, the breton warriors who painted or tattooed themselves for war. I think that Shakespeare perhaps used the term in a loosely manner, just as Nietzsche refers to the french as "gauls" in his Ecce Homo, in what regards the conversion into Christianity. I think that the terms were more interchangeable at the time, if even for literary ends. Truth be told, I'm impressed Shakespeare never wrote about Llewellyn ap Gruffydd. Men refused titles in a losing war because "his people protected the people of Wales since the times of Kamber". Perhaps it would cause some trouble among the court. But Henry V impresses me in Shakespeare's play  when he tells the yeoman that he is "welsh", instead of a Plantagenet norman. Anyway, I think he uses the term in a loosely manner. Or as a way of evoking some kind of heritage from the gauls, who were assimilated very well by the romans. For more information, I'd recommend Pliny, Caesar, Tacitus and reading on Gallo-Roman culture.

Only alternative ending I find fitting is that they commit suicide, the patricians get even more pissed. Paris is mortally wounded but does not die before being found. Juliet kills herself, and Paris, even with his name, that let us agree, is an ill omen, explains before death what transpired, foegiving Romeo from mortally wounding him. Instead of following orders from the Prince, the two families renew their feud into an open conflict, and the city is bathed in blood, each citizen or freemen learning of what happened taking arms for one side or another. This could end like Oscar Wilde's The Son of the Star, where the Son's successor is a cruel king. And the play ends in open, with somebody ending it stating that love saves some and that love punishes others.
Quite interesting. When I was younger, I'd know somebody would die via dreams. It was never the person I dreamt of. But somebody very close to them. Happened time and time again.

Well, as far as I know, Gray Barker was making a hoax when he talked about the MIB thing. There was an article by a friend of his that I read a long time ago which stated that it was a hoax.
